div.div:
Included in the schedule by default.
Optional to use, as latent fault diagnostics are performed each device reset. However, it should be used if the application requirements expects the device to remain operational for longer than the recommended interval for performing latent fault checks for the given safety standard. Runs the next diagnostic in the queue to ensure that all latent fault diagnostics are eventually run within LFDTI.

div.div:
Included in the schedule by default.
This is assumed to be scheduled whenever (typically within FDTI) notification errors in hardware should be reported to the error handler and all notification errors in the log should be processed (issue callback for each error ID).
